# Fuzzy string matching is now generally available across Microsoft SQL

## What Changed

Four native T-SQL functions that tell you how close two strings are, not just whether they’re equal. MICROSFT isn’t MICROSOFT. MARHTA isn’t MARTHA. INV-1O08 isn’t INV-1008. To an equality check, each pair is simply different. To your business, each is a near miss worth catching. Today, fuzzy string matching is generally available in Microsoft SQL. EDIT_DISTANCE tells you MICROSFT is one edit from MICROSOFT. JARO_WINKLER_SIMILARITY scores MARTHA and MARHTA at 96 out of 100. […]

A generally available capability may remove a blocker or create an expansion opportunity.
